div.p: This policy explains what happens to your payment if a booked tour is cancelled, postponed or changed, either by you or by us.

A deposit is required to confirm a booking, with the remaining balance due before the departure date shown at checkout. Deposits secure park permits, accommodation and vehicle bookings on your behalf and are non-refundable except where noted below.
Refunds for cancellations made by the lead traveler are calculated from the total tour cost, based on how far in advance we receive written notice of cancellation:
Flights, visas, travel insurance and other third-party costs booked on your behalf are subject to that provider's own cancellation terms and are not covered by this table.

We'll always try to move your booking to a new departure date at no extra cost if you ask more than 30 days before departure and space is available. Requests inside 30 days are treated as a cancellation under the table above and a new booking.

If we cancel a departure - for example due to insufficient numbers, park closures, extreme weather or events beyond our control - you'll be offered a full refund or the option to transfer your payment to another available date at no extra charge.
Contact us in writing, quoting your booking reference, using the details on our Contact Us page. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 14 business days of confirmation.
This is a general policy; specific terms for a booking are confirmed at the time of payment.
This explains what personal information we collect when you browse this site or book a tour, why we collect it, and the choices you have.
When you make a booking inquiry, create a portal account, or contact us, we collect:

ul.li: Your name, email address and phone number.
Booking details: chosen package, dates, number of travelers, and any special requests you tell us.
Payment details, handled directly by our payment provider - we do not store your card or mobile money credentials ourselves.
Confirm and manage your booking, and communicate with you about it.
Arrange accommodation, park permits and transport with our local partners.
Send booking confirmations and, if you opt in, occasional updates about our tours.
Meet our own legal and accounting obligations.

div.p: We don't sell your information. We share only what's needed to run your trip - for example your name and travel dates with the lodges, parks and drivers involved in your itinerary - and with our payment provider to process payment. Some of these partners may be located outside Kenya.
We keep booking records for as long as needed to handle your trip, resolve any dispute, and meet our accounting and tax obligations, after which it's deleted or anonymized.

Under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019, you can ask us to show you the personal data we hold about you, correct it, or delete it where we're not required to keep it for legal reasons. To do so, contact us via our Contact Us page.

Like most websites, we use cookies for things like keeping you logged in to your portal account and remembering your light/dark theme preference. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
This is a general policy; if you have questions about your data, reach us via Contact Us.
